sentences.text: MR PRAVIN GONDALIYA, ADVOCATE for the Applicant(s) No. 1
MR NJ SHAH, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1
ORAL ORDER 1.

The applicantoriginal accused of PFA Case No.11 of 2003, who is convicted by the  learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, (Muni) Surat on 27.6.2013 for the offence punishable  under Sections 16 and 7(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

Against the  said order Criminal Appeal being Criminal Appeal No.85 of 2013 was filed before the  learned Additional HC-NIC Page 1 of 3 Created On Sat Apr 29 00:43:47 IST 2017 R/CR.MA/10838/2017 ORDER Sessions Judge, Surat.
The learned Additional Sessions  Judge, Surat, by his judgment and order dated 25.4.2017 confirmed the order passed  by the learned JMFC in PFA Case No.11 of 2003.
2. Heard Mr.Pravin Gondaliya, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr.N.J.Shah, learned
Additional
Public Prosecutor for the respondentState

sentences.text: 3. Mr.Gondaliya has submitted that the sample taken by the complainant was not taken in knit  and clean vessel as required under the Rules nor there is any evidence produced by  the prosecution that the prescribed mandatory procedure has been  followed by the complainant to collect the sample.

He has, therefore, submitted that the  applicant may kindly be granted bail pending the Revision Application.
4.
Heard Mr.N.J.Shah, learned APP for the HC-NIC Page 2 of 3 Created On Sat Apr 29 00:43:47 IST 2017 R/CR.MA/10838/2017 ORDER respondent - State.
He has vehemently  opposed the present application.
5. I have gone through the papers produced before me as well as the judgment and  orders passed by both the Courts below.
6. Looking to the facts of the case, I am of the opinion that this is a fit case to grant the  bail to the applicant.

Hence, the applicant is ordered to be released on bail pending hearing  and disposal of the Revision Application on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.10,000/
 and a result of the like amount on usual terms and conditions.
Direct service is permitted.
(Z.K.SAIYED, J.) KKS HC-NIC Page 3 of 3 Created On Sat Apr 29 00:43:47 IST 2017 Damjibhai Devrajbhai Savaliya vs State Of Gujarat
